focus: maintainability -- shared literals and test surface

findingDetails.title: The arena marker's name is a literal in two modules, and no test asserts they agree
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both MARK copies and the test that writes the marker by hand are in the scoped files.
findingDetails.claim: The builder writes the marker from one literal and the runner reads it from another, with no shared import and no test comparing them.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked for a shared module that exports the marker name; there is none. Checked whether either test builds an arena and then asks the runner to accept it; no test does.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The marker name may be treated as a stable protocol string, in which case duplication is acceptable; nothing documents it as frozen.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if the marker name is documented as a frozen protocol constant.

findingDetails.title: The guards suite never exercises the builder's copy path, so the dotenv skip, the clonefile flag and the ignored-tree walk are untested
findingDetails.scopeProof: The test file is the scoped guards test and the untested code is the scoped builder.
findingDetails.claim: Both arena builder cases commit no ignored tree, so copyPlan returns nothing and the copy path has no test on any platform.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the test file for a fixture with dist, node_modules or a dotenv file; none exists. Checked other test files for a builder call; none.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The copy path may be considered too slow for CI; a single small dist tree would still cover it, and no comment states the omission is deliberate.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if an integration lane outside vitest builds a real arena with ignored trees.

traceabilityChecks.notes: Last scoped lines matched; the copy path is the only changed surface without a test.
